output.summary: Evergreen tree native to the Andean valleys of Chile, Peru and Ecuador. Its fruit ripens after falling, developing soft, very sweet, dry and floury orange-yellow flesh around large hard seeds. The ripe fruit is eaten raw or used in Peru to flavour drinks and ice cream, and its flesh can be dried into powder.
output.edibilityNote: The ripe fruit is eaten raw, used in Peruvian drinks and ice cream, and dried into powder; it was also food in Inca times.
